job: Implement one backend outcome inside a frozen mutation contract, following the observed sibling family, and return the measured conformance and proof receipt that shows the boundary was not widened.

refs.purpose: The only source of business behaviour.
The frozen mutation contract the implementation fills and may not widen.
Sibling patterns: the only source of valid conventions.
The backend checkout the boundary belongs to; the one place this operator writes product source.
Where conformance, proofs, and the receipt are written.

sideEffects: write product source only inside input.scope.mutableFileRefs
write the typed implementation receipt and every proof result under input.project.artifactRootRef
forbiddenSideEffects: add an operation, writer, store, transaction, migration, or event the frozen contract does not carry
decide a business rule that the approved authority does not state
introduce a convention no bound sibling pattern publishes
weaken, skip, suppress, or substitute a declared proof to make a run go green
edit the contract, the business authority, or a file outside the mutable ceiling
claim conformance without naming the evidence that measured it
record a quality, visual, or UAT verdict
stopConditions: the contract is not frozen or its fingerprint is stale
the outcome cannot be reached without a boundary the contract does not carry
a business question is open and no approved authority decides it
a file needing mutation lies outside the mutable ceiling
a contract aspect has no bound sibling pattern to follow
a declared proof cannot be executed in this environment
the observed source head differs from the frozen head
a resume adds no effective authority, contract, pattern, or scope delta
